Notes: Table 2, fourth row (LM6, HP1m), column B. Paper has the fancy title "the LAPM"  Also works for longer holding period of up to 2 years.
Detailed Definition: In each month, count the number of days with no trades. Define zerotrade as the number of days without trades plus (the sum of monthly turnover (vol/shrout) divided by 48*10$^5$), multiplied by 21/number of trading days per month. Zerotrade is the 6-month average of that variable.
